traps.description: SAS numeric missing (.) is mathematically smaller than negative infinity; quantity < 0 evaluates to TRUE when quantity is missing.
traps.mitigation: In COBOL, explicitly check for missing/null status before evaluating numeric inequalities.

traps.description: Special missing values .A and .Z are checked in discount_pct classification; COBOL standard lacks native special missings.
traps.mitigation: Map special missing values to distinct alphanumeric status indicators or dedicated 88-level condition names.

traps.description: SUM statement (customer_total + net_amount) automatically creates an implicit RETAIN and initializes to zero across DATA step iterations.
traps.mitigation: Declare explicit accumulator in WORKING-STORAGE and initialize to zero at control break header.

traps.description: Explicit PUT and INPUT functions coerce numeric to formatted string and text back to numeric with potential rounding discrepancies.
traps.mitigation: Utilize COBOL edited PIC clauses and FUNCTION NUMVAL-C with explicit precision guards.

traps.description: Match-merge requires strict ascending order on BY key customer_id; customer_sales requires both inputs pre-sorted.
traps.mitigation: Implement sequential two-file match-merge loop using HIGH-VALUES sentinel key handling.

traps.description: One-to-many relationship between customer and sales preserves customer fields across multiple sales records in SAS PDV.
traps.mitigation: Implement master-transaction loop retaining master record in storage across transaction stream.

traps.description: IN= variables (in_customer, in_sale) emulate inner join filter (if in_customer and in_sale).
traps.mitigation: Evaluate match status in match-merge loop: process output only when master-key = transaction-key.

traps.description: Non-retained attributes in DATA step with OUTPUT on LAST.variable reflect values from the last observation, not the first.
traps.mitigation: Explicitly capture first-observation attributes in WORKING-STORAGE upon FIRST.key control break.

traps.description: SAS date values are integer offsets since Jan 1, 1960; date functions intnx and intck operate on this epoch.
traps.mitigation: Convert SAS date integers to Gregorian YYYYMMDD or Lilian dates via Language Environment date callable services (CEEDAYS/CEEDATE).

traps.description: FIRST.customer_id is referenced without a corresponding BY customer_id statement in WORKLIB.customer_base, causing SAS compile failure.
traps.mitigation: Flag as source defect; in COBOL, either require upstream sort and control break or treat as unanchored logic.

traps.description: Conditional SET executed only on _N_=1 without an unconditional SET or STOP causes an infinite execution loop in SAS.
traps.mitigation: Read single-record control file once in initialization paragraph and terminate batch loop explicitly.

traps.description: _N_ iteration counter used to trigger header record loading; _N_ is dropped from output dataset automatically.
traps.mitigation: Implement internal record counter in WORKING-STORAGE.

traps.description: Explicit OUTPUT on LAST.customer_id suppresses default implicit output at bottom of DATA step, writing only summary rows.
traps.mitigation: Emit summary record only inside control-break finalization paragraph; omit record emission in detail paragraph.

traps.description: Variables formatted with comma14.2 and date9. alter display representation without altering internal binary/float representation.
traps.mitigation: Store numeric values in COMP-3 (packed decimal) and format into display structures for output.

traps.description: WORKLIB.final_customer_profile overwrites itself in-place across successive DATA steps.
traps.mitigation: Assign separate physical intermediate DD names (e.g. CUSTPRF1, CUSTPRF2) in JCL job stream.

traps.description: PROC SUMMARY and FREQ generate automatic columns (_TYPE_, _FREQ_, COUNT, PERCENT) in output tables.
traps.mitigation: Explicitly specify record layout in output copybook including count and frequency accumulators.

traps.description: LEFT JOIN in PROC SQL produces SQL NULLs for unmatched rows, which convert to SAS missing (.) or spaces.
traps.mitigation: Use DB2 SQL indicator variables (:VAR :VAR-IND) or COBOL 88-level null sentinels.

traps.description: Macro %build_region_report dynamically generates alternative DATA step code paths based on &region parameter.
traps.mitigation: Static COBOL programs must handle parameter filtering via run-time linkage-section or PARM evaluation.

traps.description: LIBNAME RAW points to external unmanaged physical schema; field lengths and types must be pinned via copybooks.
traps.mitigation: Map SAS external datasets to mainframe QSAM files / VSAM datasets defined in JCL DD statements.

traps.description: Variable name collision in match-merge: sales_sorted.region silently overwrites customer_sorted.region in the PDV.
traps.mitigation: In COBOL Working-Storage, maintain separate prefixed fields (CUST-REGION vs SALE-REGION) to prevent silent data clobbering.

traps.description: Fatal sequence violation: daily_sales runs BY sale_date on WORKLIB.sales_sorted which is sorted by customer_id first.
traps.mitigation: Inject DFSORT step in JCL to re-sort transaction stream by sale_date before daily aggregation.

traps.description: Match-merge key mismatch and sequence defect: region_channel_summary contains region (not customer_region) and region_report is sorted by sales desc.
traps.mitigation: Standardize join key naming and inject explicit DFSORT steps in JCL before match-merge.

traps.description: Missing quantity and unit_price evaluate as < 0 in DATA step validation, misclassifying missing records as negative values.
traps.mitigation: In COBOL, explicitly check for missing/uninitialized state before evaluating negative value validation rules.
